target_customer: Entrepreneurs and small companies that want AI agents running marketing, research, sales and operations work
problem: Isolated AI chat agents need constant prompting and manual context passing; teams want proactive agents that hand work to each other and escalate only real decisions.
business_model: SaaS subscription for an agent workspace; pricing not published; invite only early access
product_category: Multi agent workspace for business work

founders.name: Mike Molinet
founders.background_notes: Launch post says Branch grew to $100M+ ARR with Kavaturi.

founders.name: Govind Kavaturi
founders.background_notes: Early at Branch per the YC page; education not listed.

competitors.name: OpenAI Workspace Agents
competitors.what: Shared team agents in ChatGPT and Slack
competitors.traction_then: Research preview launched April 22 2026 for business plans

competitors.name: Microsoft Copilot Cowork
competitors.what: Delegated multi step tasks across Microsoft apps

competitors.name: Asana AI work suite
competitors.what: Human and agent teams working on shared work

technical_complexity.rationale: Runs its own agent harness and runtime with memory, schedules and cloud or local execution; hard parts are reliability and integrations rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Large platforms ship similar team agent features and the product is early; persistent agent memory and workspace data could create switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenAI, Microsoft and Asana shipped team agent features in April to June 2026.

market_need_then: Interest in agents as coworkers was high in 2026; founders say they run their own company on Dock. No customer or revenue evidence found.

branding.domain_note: Uses trydock.ai, a try prefix variant; several unrelated companies use Dock names, including dock.io and dock.us.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise: Your team goes multiplayer, Your company never stops working

branding.brand_signature: Agents with job titles like Chief of Staff and Lead Researcher

brand_strength.rationale: A very generic name used by multiple companies on a prefixed domain, with no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Dock is an active Summer 2026 company from two repeat founders whose earlier company Branch reportedly reached $100M+ ARR. It is in invite only early access with no verified funding or customers. The main risk is platform incumbents bundling team agents, so it must win through depth of agent autonomy and workspace stickiness.
notes: No disclosed round found; aggregators list only Y Combinator S26. Operated by Vector Apps Inc per the website. Several other companies named Dock (dock.us, dock.io) were excluded. Roles: YC page says Founder/CEO and Co-Founder. Competitors are large platform launches from search summaries of 2026 press.
